build_resnet50_conv4_body: build a ResNet50 conv4 body by calling add_ResNet50_conv4_body with a Detectron model
build_resnet101_conv5_body: build a ResNet101 conv5 body by calling add_ResNet101_conv5_body with a Detectron model
build_resnet_stage: build a ResNet stage by calling add_stage with n residual blocks and dimension parameters
build_residual_block: build a residual block by calling add_residual_block with transformation and shortcut functions
build_bottleneck_transformation: build a bottleneck transformation by calling bottleneck_transformation with 1x1-3x3-1x1 conv layers
